## A little about me

I'm a native English speaker with a PhD in linguistics and extensive experience teaching English.

My background in linguistics helps me explain not just what English speakers say, but why the language works the way it does.

## My approach

I believe effective language teaching combines practical communication with a clear understanding of the language.

My lessons are adapted to each learner. Some people want to sound clearer when speaking; others need confidence in meetings, university seminars or everyday conversation.

We focus on the skills that will make a real difference to you.

## Experience and qualifications

- PhD in linguistics.
- Extensive English teaching experience.
- Experience working with international students and professionals.
- Specialist knowledge of English pronunciation and spoken language.
